images.$comment: Image slots (JUS-52). Resolution at render time: prospect override -> template default -> styled placeholder. hero shows a prospect override (neutral alt); projectKitchen is alt-only (placeholder url); projectFeatured is omitted entirely; empty objects resolve to placeholders. services.title: Remodeling, handled with care.
services.lede: Focused services for homeowners who want the work done right — without the runaround.

items.title: Kitchen Remodeling
items.summary: Thoughtful kitchen updates designed around better flow, storage, finishes, and everyday function.
items.detailTitle: Kitchen remodels, planned around how you cook
items.detailCopy: From refreshed surfaces to full layout changes, we plan the work around your routines — clear timelines, contained dust, and a space that works better the moment it’s done.
items.goodFit: A good fit if your layout works but the finishes, storage, or workflow no longer do.

items.title: Bathroom Remodeling
items.summary: Refresh your bathroom with cleaner layouts, updated surfaces, improved fixtures, and a more comfortable feel.
items.detailTitle: Bathrooms that stay practical and feel finished
items.detailCopy: We handle the details that make a bathroom last — proper waterproofing, ventilation, and surfaces that are easy to keep clean — with a schedule you can plan around.
items.goodFit: A good fit if you want a bathroom that works better day to day, not just a new look.

items.title: Whole-Home Updates
items.summary: Modernize key areas of your home with coordinated improvements that make the space feel more complete.
items.detailCopy: Instead of juggling separate contractors, we sequence flooring, trim, lighting, and room-by-room updates under one plan — so the house stays livable and the work stays on track.
items.goodFit: A good fit if several areas need attention at once and you want one team coordinating it.

steps.title: Request an Estimate
steps.copy: Tell us what you’re hoping to improve and the best way to reach you.

steps.title: Walk Through the Project
steps.copy: We review the space, goals, timeline, and details that matter most.

steps.title: Review a Clear Proposal
steps.copy: You get a straightforward scope so you can make a confident decision.

steps.title: Schedule the Work
steps.copy: Once approved, we coordinate the next steps and keep the project moving.

serviceArea.lede: Cascade Home Remodeling works with homeowners throughout Bend and the surrounding area.

finalCta.headline: Ready to talk about your remodel?
finalCta.copy: Tell us what you have in mind and we’ll help you take the next step.
finalCta.micro: No pressure, no obligation — just a clear next step.
